title: Role-conditioned logical MLPs through a shared transcoder feature basis
hypothesis: For 16 relation-task roles, task-specific Givens coordinates over selected sparse transcoder activations can produce input-dependent MLP residual Views that preserve explicit support-derived MLP-delta quality within .20 gold-logprob nats/.05 accuracy, stay within 2x explicit-delta payload bytes, and beat equal-size pairwise gains and a stronger per-feature gate by >=.10 gold-logprob nats on both development seeds.
physical_object: Pinned Pythia-70m layer-3 MLP plus a 2048-feature top-32 transcoder trained only on support prompt tokens from tasks0-11.
mirror_coordinate: Eight Givens angles per task rotate eight fixed pairs of a shared 16-feature transcoder activation slice before decoding through shared transcoder output atoms.
logical_multiplicity: Sixteen relation-task-specific nonlinear MLP delta functions selected by an externally supplied task-role ID. Role selection is oracle-addressed and evaluated separately from learned routing; 16 codes do not imply 16 independent capacities.

task.primary_metric: heldout gold candidate log probability under role-conditioned MLP delta

transcoder.architecture: 512-to-2048 affine ReLU encoder, per-token top-32 activations, 2048-to-512 affine decoder
transcoder.training_target: same layer-3 MLP output from post-attention layernorm input
transcoder.training_data: All sequence-token positions from support demonstration prompts of tasks0-11 only; no heldout query prompt is used.
transcoder.optimizer: Adam lr=.001, exactly 1000 updates, batch128, MSE + .001 mean absolute top-32 latent activation; seed0.
transcoder.selected_basis: Pool of 16 transcoder latent IDs selected by residual correlation to support-derived MLP-output delta targets from tasks0-11 only; stable tie breaks. Store only selected encoder rows+biases and decoder rows at inference.

support_targets.input: For each support query, the query-only bare prompt provides x at layer3 MLP input.
support_targets.target: The layer3 MLP output at the same final prefix position under the prompt with the other seven support demonstrations minus the output under the bare prompt.
support_targets.role_adaptation: Fit a separate role code for each task using its eight support input/target pairs; task IDs12-15 support may fit their codes, but their eight evaluation queries stay withheld.

views.givens: For pooled top-32 transcoder activations z(x), rotate fixed pairs (0,1),(2,3),...,(14,15) with eight task angles, then multiply by the selected shared decoder rows to form an additive layer3 MLP-output delta.
views.pairwise_gains: Equal-size native control: one learned scalar per fixed feature pair, same eight FP32 values/task and same optimizer updates.
views.elementwise_feature_gates: Strong native control: one independently learned scalar for each of the 16 selected latent features, 16 FP32 values/task.
views.fit: Fit each role-specific code by MSE to its eight support MLP-delta vectors; Adam lr=.01, exactly 500 updates/task, no tuning.
views.feature_input: Selected 16 paid encoder rows are evaluated directly with ReLU at inference. Givens/gain/gate operations act on these selected activations. The full 2048-row dictionary is not used or needed by the deployed view.

controls: Explicit per-role mean MLP-delta bank (upper/activation-vector control)
Task-specific per-feature multiplicative gates (strong sparse-gating control)

fresh.opening_rule: Only if both development seeds pass heldout causal-quality, bytes, and both native feature-gate margins.

paid_objects: selected 16 transcoder encoder rows+bias and decoder rows+bias
explicit MLP-delta vector bank for the explicit upper control
storage.accounting: Candidate contains only the selected input/output basis required for feature encoding/decoding plus task codes; no full 2048-feature transcoder or decoded delta cache. Report standalone Pythia+View and explicit-delta totals.
storage.selected_basis: The support-trained 2048-feature top-32 transcoder selects 16 encoder/decoder atom pairs. Deployment directly evaluates ReLU on those 16 paid encoder rows (all selected coordinates are available); it does not claim to reconstruct the full-dictionary global top-32 mask. Training still uses global top-32 sparsity. This is the executable 16-atom functional view.

compute.optimizer_updates: 1000 transcoder + 500 updates per role for each of three code controls
compute.active_compute_proxy: Report support MLP capture; transcoder fit; per-role support gate optimization; selected-feature encode/rotate/decode; original transformer candidate sequences.

gates.PASS: Both dev seeds: Givens within .05 accuracy/.20 gold-logprob nats of explicit MLP-delta bank; Givens total payload <=2.0x explicit bank; Givens beats pairwise and per-feature gates by >=.10 gold-logprob nats on both seeds; replay exact.
gates.FAIL: Any frozen quality, byte or native-control gate fails.
gates.NOT_ESTABLISHED: Pinned model, support/query integrity, deterministic replay or payload accounting fails.

boundaries: Task role IDs are externally supplied; learned query routing is not tested.
Only one small LM, layer, transcoder and 16 relation tasks.
Role-specific gains are support-adapted interventions, not separate trained dense MLPs.
Do not call the 16 roles independent expert capacity.
Fresh seeds stay sealed if any frozen gate misses.
